en: When enabled, humidity recommendations use the estimated relative humidity at each room's coldest surface instead of raw RH. Calibrate each room under the Room settings menu; an uncalibrated room remains unknown rather than safe.

Optional Home Assistant warning entities. An explicitly active warning adds an outdoor-air caution and blocks automatic window-opening advice. Unavailable or unknown warnings are reported as missing evidence, not treated as active warnings; separate weather, pollution and equipment safety checks still apply. Select verified warning entities rather than ordinary weather conditions.
Direct speech provider when Announcement Hub is not used.
Direct audio destinations; room assignment controls targeting.
Disabled by default. New open recommendations need 90 seconds of stable conditions.

These limits apply to instantaneous sensor values and are configurable guidance, not health or exposure standards. AQI assumes the US 0-500 scale by default; change the limits for any differently scaled provider.
